The clean completion path is binding (b): `hh-kernel serve` stdio JSON-RPC — `hello` → `open_session{new, document: clients/ts/fixture-definition.json}` → `submit[{kind:"invoke",capability:"hh.submit",args:{}}]` → `read` → `lifecycle.run.finished{status:"succeeded",stop_reason:{kind:"completed"}}`.
